title: Wilton Police Make Second Arrest in $333K Fraud Tied to Police Headquarters Construction - NewsBreak
text:
By Heather Borden Herve, GMW Editor ,
8 hours ago Wilton Police have made a second arrest in a years-long investigation into a stolen Town of Wilton check connected to construction of the town’s new police headquarters. On Wednesday, June 3, Wilton Police extradited a Bronx, NY, man accused of receiving and withdrawing approximately $150,000 from a fraudulently obtained town check. The suspect, 26-year-old Mahamadou Sillah of the Bronx, was arraigned in Connecticut after being taken into custody with assistance from the NYPD Bronx Warrant Squad. Read full article
